nodes.name: Brave Search

parameters.url: =https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search?q={{ encodeURIComponent($json.name + ' 2026 speakers CFP audience size deadline') }}&count=3

nodes.notes: Brave Search credential should be named 'Brave Search' (httpHeaderAuth) with header X-Subscription-Token = <your Brave API key>.
